notes.title: UPDATE 6 (10 vs 10, Character Voice)
notes.content:
1. Added 10 vs 10 option in battle mode.

2. The voice of the character has been added, and now the voice will be played when the character gets hurt or died.

3. Fixed the volume adjustment UI.

notes.title: UPDATE 5 (Key Binding)
notes.content:
1. Added key binding function.

2. Added mouse adjustment function.

3. The standing AI in the Line Mode will not spawn during the countdown.

notes.title: UPDATE 4 (New Feature - Wardrobe)
notes.content: With more and more clothes, we need a wardrobe.

notes.title: UPDATE 3 (New Game Mode, New Clothes)
notes.content:
1. Added Line game mode, players need to guard the last line of defense to prevent AI robots from passing.

2. Two sets of clothes are added, which can be unlocked through the Line mode.

3. The second set of clothes in zombie mode is changed to unlock after 20 waves.

notes.title: UPDATE 2 (Important)
notes.content:
As more and more players complained about long-range shot spread and damage falloff, I realized I had to make a change.

1. Now the assault rifle's long-range shooting spread effect has been weakened by 80% (40% for pistols) on the original basis, so now you can shoot very accurately at long-distance enemies without worrying too much about the spread of the shot, but this also means You have to aim very precisely at the enemy's body.

2. Now the long-range damage falloff effect of the assault rifle is weakened by 35% on the original basis (20% for the pistol). For example, the assault rifle can cause 6 points of damage to the super long-distance enemy before, but now it can cause 8 points.

3. The healing effect of the health kit is now increased by 100% on the original basis, which means that it can now restore 1/3 of health.

With the completion of this update, I think the real battle has begun, and the abilities of humans and AI have been further evened out. Now the test is accuracy, agility, and a little luck.

Hope you enjoy this update.

notes.title: UPDATE 1 (Improve game experience and roadmap)
notes.content:
According to player feedback, the game has been updated several times since the release date. The main updates are as follows:

1. Added health packs to the map.

2. Reduced the AI damage of exploding zombies.

3. Zombies will hardly spawn from nearby.

4. Zombies with more than five waves will not be refreshed at one time, but will be refreshed in batches.

6. The character models of teammate AI will no longer be all the same.

7. The clothes that need to be unlocked for 20 waves of zombies are changed to unlock for 15 waves of zombies.

8. Fix some bugs.

9. Various small modifications to improve the game experience.

After the updates in the initial stage, I think the fun and difficulty of the game have achieved a certain balance, which can meet the needs of most players.


Roadmap:

I'm working on a new game mode, and of course there will be new clothes, so stay tuned.
